item.title: Said & Checked, Health, 2026-11-19: none false or contradicted, 1 unsettled (Bernie Sanders)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsettled

  • Bernie Sanders, U.S. Senator from Vermont: “Jeffries basically supported the first year of Medicare for All” Unsettled. Jeffries has not stated opposition to expanding Medicare eligibility and benefits, but the reported House Democratic discussions of a lower Medicare age and added dental, vision and hearing coverage rest on anonymous sources, and his on-record priorities read here cover only reversing Medicaid cuts and restoring ACA subsidies. The match is partial, and "basically" is a loose term.

item.title: Said & Checked, Health, 2026-11-15: none false or contradicted, 2 unsupported, 3 unsettled (Bill Cassidy)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsupported and Unsettled

  • Bill Cassidy, U.S. Senator from Louisiana: “So, I'm in regular contact with the CDC director.” Unsupported. No page that could be read shows how often the senator and the CDC director are in contact. The search covered web searches on the two and the warehouse catalog, which holds no record of contacts between members and officials.
  • Bill Cassidy, U.S. Senator from Louisiana: “And then she texted back to say it's been broken for a year. And so she's working to fix it.” Unsupported. No page that could be read says how long the federal flu-shot locator was broken or records the CDC director's reply. The search covered the vaccine locator site, the flu-shot locator and the CDC director; an NBC News page on the subject failed to load.
  • Bill Cassidy, U.S. Senator from Louisiana: “He was supposed to be doing something positive on ultra-processed foods. That's what MAHA moms wanted. There's been minimal progress.” Unsettled. A trade outlet, Food Industry Executive, reported that the FDA and the health department sent a proposed definition of ultra-processed food to the White House budget office in August 2026 as a white paper, not a rule. No final rule, standard or definition was found, but the submission itself was not read, and "minimal progress" is a judgment the record cannot settle exactly.
